baseline.description: Preserved release binary from immediately before the flow-Unknown-barrier increment. The intervening increment is independently accepted in type-inference-flow-unknown-proof-barrier-2026-08-08.json.

semantic_evidence.red_reproduction: value = Product.new; flag && (value = "fallback"); value.upcase incorrectly treated the conditional assignment as unconditional, reported String for value, and could resolve String#upcase even though Product reaches the call.
semantic_evidence.accepted_short_circuit_rule: The left operand always executes. Proven Ruby truthiness determines whether the right operand executes always, never, or conditionally. A conditional right operand joins the skipped and executed environments, and the expression result retains only left-side members that actually short-circuit plus the right result. Unproven evidence remains explained Unknown.
semantic_evidence.accepted_completion_rule: Completion for a user-defined union receiver intersects method names across every member, requires identical parameter contracts, and unions only proven return types. A method missing from any reachable member is not offered.
semantic_evidence.architecture: Both rules live in ruby-analysis inference/engine code. The CLI and LSP adapters consume the same engine-owned outcomes and add no type rule.
